content: CockroachDB pkg/util/hlc: Clock (mutex-guarded wall+logical) with Now()/Update(ClockTimestamp); WallClock interface injected via NewClockForTesting; HybridManualClock (Pause/Forward/Increment) for tests; Logger interface + StartMonitoringForwardClockJumps goroutine for jump/drift warnings; Timestamp value type (timestamp.proto) with Less/Compare/Forward/Backward; distinct ClockTimestamp (local) vs Timestamp (wire) types.
